localOcrExperiment.measurement: Upper-bound occurrence of issuer, invoice number, date, VAT and gross tokens. Does not prove field binding, uniqueness or acceptable automatic-fill accuracy.
localOcrExperiment.decision: Do not enable image OCR; retain manual review. Results apply only to this tested engine, preprocessing and corpus.

privacy: Original PDFs, extracted text, expected values, identities, screenshots and Morning responses remain in ignored local working files.
scope: Diagnostic corpus, not an untouched holdout: baseline failures were examined to develop the new template rules. Historical agreement is measured separately from source correctness.
